Antwerp, Belgium9 contributions

Best meal we’ve had in Vietnam! Outstanding food and wonderful service!
Nov 2025 • Friends
We arrived unexpectedly with a group of 12, but the staff immediately made room for us and set everything up in no time. From the very first moment, the service was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The food was amazing—honestly the best I’ve had in Vietnam! I ordered the ribs, and they were absolutely perfect, but everyone at the table couldn’t stop praising their dishes either.

To top it off, the owner treated us to a complimentary drink afterwards. Such a wonderful evening and truly delicious food! I rarely write reviews, but these people absolutely deserve it!
Written November 4, 2025

Eaten well
Oct 2025 • Couples
Eaten here with a rainy day. Was very quiet. Chosen for the shrimp in dough with lemon mayonnaise as a starter. Shrimp tasty, but found the amount of dough a little too thick and too powerful. Then sissling hot chicken with lemon and chicken with honey. The plates come out of the oven so the meat and vegetables steam a bit more. All in all delicious food and the price is completely in order. I would definitely recommend this restaurant!
